why: Invalid. The VM was paused from about 00:57:47Z to 03:47:29Z: the wall clock advanced about 2 h 50 min that the uptime clock (and the running processes' elapsed time) did not, in the middle of the test phase, so every wall-clock figure spanning it is wrong. why: Stopped by the spike's disk watchdog at 05:21:54Z with 2,445 MB free on /home (it stops the chain below 2,560 MB). Free space fell from 29 GB to 1.7 GB in about 40 minutes; about 7.5 GB of that was this clone's cargo target, the rest other sessions on the shared host. Load average 35–57 on 14 vCPUs. No summary was written.

name: Attempt 3 — `just gate` Nx-cold with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, same clone
why: Invalid as a gate figure: exited 1 after 2,568 s (no pause; uptime clock 2,583 s). The e2e tier refused because onetaskgraph 0.7.0 was missing from the clone's target/tools (this spike had deleted the clone's target/ after attempt 2 to free disk, and bootstrap installs that tool there); the note tier's first 4 journeys failed (nextest then cancelled the rest: `4/30 tests run: 0 passed, 4 failed`) reading /home/nick.guest/ai-orchestrator/onetaskgraph.yaml, a configuration the clone found by walking up from its location under that tree; and test-rest's provisioning journey failed for the same missing tool. Both causes are the spike's setup, not the repository. Its completed cold tasks are kept as partial figures (attempt3-gate-cold.json).
